lines.text: System One / Jev workshops (Docker + make only)
make help       Show this help
make build      Build the Docker image (pinned Python deps, amd64/arm64)
make lite       Talk demo: Jev emulator + 3 examples (EX=ticket|comment|approval)
make lite-mock  Talk demo fully offline (MOCK rules, no key, no network)
make emulator   Run only the Jev emulator on http://127.0.0.1:8787 (Ctrl+C stops)
make curl       Plain-curl request to a running `make emulator` (curl runs in Docker)
make workshop   Deep dive: ex1, ex2, ex3 in a row (MOCK=1 for offline)
make ex1        Deep dive ex1: classic classifier baseline (no LLM, no key)
make ex2        Deep dive ex2: free LLM forced into decision shape (LIMIT, K)
make ex3        Deep dive ex3: confidence-gated cascade, LLM as System 2 (THRESHOLD)
make ex3-sweep  Deep dive ex3: threshold sweep with a human queue (no LLM)
make ex4        Deep dive ex4: real decision APIs (skips providers without keys)
make decider    Deep dive: one decider.py call (choice + noul + score)
make models     List current free OpenRouter models (needs network)
make shell      Open a shell in the container
make test       Offline smoke tests (MOCK, --network none, no key): what CI runs
make test-live  One real call through the free OpenRouter model (needs key)
make clean      Remove the local image
Options: MOCK=1 (offline, no key)  FALLBACK= (no mock fallback)  EX=ticket|comment|approval
LIMIT=15 K=3 (ex2)  THRESHOLD=0.6 (ex3)  PORT=8787 (emulator)  MOUNT=0 (use code baked in image)
Env file: ~/rnd-research/system-one-models/presentation/workshop-lite/.env
